KAVYA REDDY
Backend Engineer · Hyderabad, India
kavya.reddy.backend@example.com · +91 90000 56789 · github.com/kavyareddy · kavyareddy.dev

SUMMARY
Backend engineer with 4.3 years of experience in payments reconciliation, ledgers and public-sector data platforms. I
like systems where every rupee, and every record, has to be accounted for.

EXPERIENCE

Northwind Hollow International Payments & Financial Infrastructure Technologies Private Limited — Senior Backend Software Development Engineer II, Payments Reconciliation, Settlement & Ledger Platform (Core Money Movement Infrastructure Group)    Hyderabad · Jan 2024 – Present
- Own the reconciliation service that matches 3.2 million card and bank transactions a day against the ledger; the
  nightly run time dropped from 5 hours to 55 minutes.
- Designed the event-sourced, append-only multi-currency settlement ledger now used by 4 downstream teams.
- Reduced unmatched-transaction exceptions from 2.1% to 0.4% with deterministic matching rules and a review workbench.
- On the platform on-call rotation; led 6 incident reviews and closed 23 follow-up actions.

Brightwater Municipal Smart-City Data Exchange & Citizen Services Cooperative Society — Associate Software Engineer (Backend Services, Integrations & Public Data APIs)    Pune · Jul 2022 – Dec 2023
- Built REST and gRPC services that publish ward-level service data to 11 municipal departments.
- Replaced a nightly CSV exchange with an event feed, cutting data lag from 24 hours to 15 minutes.
- Wrote integration adapters for 7 legacy department systems.

PROJECTS
- Event-Sourced Multi-Currency Settlement Ledger with Automated Exception Handling and Reconciliation Workbench —
  Append-only ledger with idempotent postings and an exception review UI. Java, PostgreSQL, Kafka.
  https://kavyareddy.dev/engineering/case-studies/2025/event-sourced-multi-currency-settlement-ledger-with-automated-exception-handling-and-reconciliation-workbench/architecture-decision-records/adr-0042-append-only-ledger-and-idempotent-posting?utm_source=resume&utm_medium=pdf&utm_campaign=portfolio-fixture-long-url
- Open-Source Distributed Rate-Limiting and Quota Enforcement Library for Multi-Tenant gRPC and REST Gateways —
  Token-bucket and sliding-window limiters with per-tenant quotas. Go.
  github.com/kavyareddy/multi-tenant-ratelimit-and-quota-enforcement-library
- Citizen Grievance Routing and Escalation Service for Municipal Ward Offices and Department Heads — Pilot with 3 ward
  offices; routes and escalates complaints by SLA. Python, FastAPI.

EDUCATION
B.Tech, Information Technology — Jawaharlal Nehru Technological University Hyderabad College of Engineering Science and Technology    2018 – 2022

SKILLS
Languages: Java, Go, Python, SQL
Systems: PostgreSQL, Kafka, gRPC, REST, Docker, Kubernetes basics
Practices: event sourcing, idempotent design, reconciliation, incident reviews, code review

# Event-Sourced Multi-Currency Settlement Ledger with Automated Exception Handling and Reconciliation Workbench

URL: https://kavyareddy.dev/engineering/case-studies/2025/event-sourced-multi-currency-settlement-ledger-with-automated-exception-handling-and-reconciliation-workbench/architecture-decision-records/adr-0042-append-only-ledger-and-idempotent-posting?utm_source=resume&utm_medium=pdf&utm_campaign=portfolio-fixture-long-url
Description: Architecture write-up of the append-only settlement ledger and the reconciliation workbench built at Northwind Hollow International Payments & Financial Infrastructure Technologies Private Limited.

## Problem
Nightly reconciliation of 3.2 million transactions a day took 5 hours and left 2.1% of transactions unmatched for manual review.

## Design
- Append-only, event-sourced ledger with idempotent postings (ADR-0042).
- Deterministic matching rules applied in three passes; unmatched items go to a review workbench with an audit trail.
- Multi-currency postings with explicit rounding rules.

## Results
- Nightly run time: 5 hours to 55 minutes.
- Unmatched exceptions: 2.1% to 0.4%.
- Adopted by 4 downstream teams.

## Observations
- The page states the outcome clearly; the diagram has no alt text.
